metadata.reference_profile_definition: Training-only feature medians and deterministic lexical mode, calculated from the exact saved model training split after applying its saved TRAIN-fitted segmentation transform.

uncertainty_definitions.aleatoric: A future customer outcome remains uncertain even if the probability is correct.
uncertainty_definitions.empirical_calibration: Bootstrap intervals quantify finite-sample uncertainty in observed group-level evaluation metrics.
uncertainty_definitions.epistemic: Uncertainty in fitted model parameters is not estimated by these fixed-model intervals.
